title: The Far End of the Fin Is Cold
summary: A longer cooling fin always dissipates more heat and always dissipates less per millimetre of metal. Put two fins side by side and watch the second one waste its length.

sources.title: Incropera and DeWitt, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, chapter 3: extended surfaces
Schneider, Conduction Heat Transfer (fin efficiency and the corrected length)
